statement.zh: 教科文将拉帕努伊国家公园表述为以摩艾石像与阿胡平台为标志的波利尼西亚仪礼景观（UNESCO 715）。
statement.en: UNESCO frames Rapa Nui National Park as a Polynesian ceremonial landscape marked by moai statues and ahu platforms (UNESCO 715).
